source_selection: Four development incident/report groups; four evaluation groups. Related updates stay with their incident but are not extra trials. Two other groups are audit-only. No source replacement after outcomes.
task: Judge whether one written claim is supported, contradicted, or not established by the supplied report excerpt. This is report interpretation, not root-cause discovery or verification against telemetry.
composition: Rules answer when their fixed literal condition applies; otherwise use eligible Jev. Conflicts or invalid answers require review. Both standalone Jev and the hybrid use the same recorded reply. Rules must not read reference labels.
input: One claim plus the unchanged contiguous prefix of complete extracted blocks, at most 14000 UTF-8 bytes. Preserve wording, polarity, qualifiers and order. Exclude URL, allocation, identity checks and reference annotations.
references: Assistant-written claims and assistant-reviewed references with exact local block spans, scope and rationale. Independent publisher authorship does not make these references independent. Ambiguous references remain unscored with their planned slots disclosed; freeze the pack before calls.

development_gate.invalid_or_missing_responses: Count as withheld and retain in all planned denominators.

evaluation_gate: Only execute evaluation after the sole hybrid candidate passes every development criterion. Apply the same criteria without edits. Do not select a replacement candidate from standalone Jev results.
freeze_before_calls: Literal rules and hybrid composition code
Definitions, questions, choices and exact wire bytes
Producer fingerprints and full request-size checks
Once-only execution and complete failure-inclusive scorer
public_evidence: Publish URLs, hashes, scoped paraphrases, choices, probabilities, failures and paired scores. Full reports, exact full-text requests and source HTML stay in ignored local runs. Replay requires matching local publisher snapshots; a fresh fetch may differ.
limitations: Purposive small public sample; not a prevalence or operational error estimate.
Sources were inspected during the audit; evaluation is separated by incident, not wholly unseen to the assistant.
Published postmortems use hindsight and may be in model pretraining.
Zero human or independent specialist reference reviews.
No telecom telemetry, anomaly-detection or live triage claim.
A probability threshold is a fixed display policy, not a calibrated error guarantee.
